---
name: Success Criterion correction
about: Report an error, outdated information, or missing detail in a success criterion
title: "[SC X.X.X] Brief description of the issue"
labels: correction
assignees: ''
---

**Success Criterion**
SC number and name — e.g. SC 1.4.3 — Contrast (Minimum) (Level AA)

**File affected**
e.g. `references/principles/1-perceivable.md`

**What is incorrect or missing**
A clear description of the problem.

**What it should say**
The correct or updated content.

**Source**
Link to the relevant W3C documentation, WCAG Understanding document, or technique:
- WCAG 2.2 spec: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/
- Understanding WCAG 2.2: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/
- WCAG Techniques: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/
